name: diagnostic_v1
use: the L40S engineering check's inputs (configs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/l40s_check.json): their generations measure memory and throughput only. NEVER training, calibration or evaluation data; admission.py, build_tasks' order and the teacher session never read this file
not_covered: the external generators' cells (their construction needs an isolated export) and MBPP's (exhausted by the order): their share goes to their stratum's other cells, and the code stratum has none here

seed_rules.project: R5 lo + 900,000 + group index x 1,000 + i (the order's block is lo + 500,000 + group index x 10,000 + i)
seed_rules.datasets: build_supporting_tasks._order (its SALT), past every pooled and ordered task

disjoint_from: T0, order_v1 and every pool, by task id and content; eval-set-1's held-out prompts and the calibration prompts by prompt key (isolate)
license: project-generated tasks; MATH (MIT) and SQuAD v2 (CC-BY-SA-4.0) train splits only
